text:
Emily Park: :rotating_light: customer escalation from acme-inc. They report repeated 5xx/504s and long timeouts for hosted inference endpoints between 11:12-11:18 UTC. They included a sample API response: {"error":"gateway timeout","status":504,"request_id":"req_ABC123"}. This looks like requests are queuing while backend pods are initializing and then hitting gateway timeout. No title — forwarding here to eng-sre + oncall.

Liao Chen: can you paste the gateway logs and recent scale events? any deploys at ~11:00?

Emily Park: deploy around 10:58 (minor routing change). Pasted gist of api gateway traces and request ids below. Also customers say latency spikes correlated with bursts (thundering herd) after periods of low traffic.

Sanjay Patel: suspect KEDA/HPA interplay. If KEDA scaled to 0, and KEDA polling interval + cold model init > gateway timeout -> 504s. Did we have minReplicas=0 for that model pool?

Sam Ortega: grabbing k8s events now. Quick checks: output from `kubectl describe hpa model-serving-prod` shows minReplicas: 0, maxReplicas: 50. KEDA ScaledObject pollPeriod: 30s, cooldownPeriod: 300s. Readiness/liveness probes for model-container: initialDelaySeconds: 5, timeoutSeconds: 30, periodSeconds: 10. Model init logs show 42s to load weights.

AutoScaleBot: detected spike. Actions taken: evaluated scale request, emitted scale event at 11:13:04, scaled from 0 -> 3 pods, pods started at 11:13:14 but readiness failed until 11:13:56.

Marie Nguyen: customer timeline looks like this: 11:12:50 request arrives -> KEDA triggers -> gateway waits ~30s -> gateway times out at ~11:13:20 -> customer sees 504. The leader problem is model init > readiness timeout AND gateway timeout configured too low for coldstart path.

Sanjay Patel: logs snippet from the pod init:
```
[2026-03-15T11:13:16Z] model-server: loading checkpoints...
[2026-03-15T11:13:35Z] model-server: kv-cache warmup start
[2026-03-15T11:13:52Z] model-server: model ready, loaded weights (42.1s)
[2026-03-15T11:13:53Z] kubelet: Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe returned code 504
```
We see readiness probe failed several times while model was still initializing; probe timeout is 30s, but model init takes ~42s.

Liao Chen: reproduction steps we used in staging:
1) set traffic to 0 for 10m to let KEDA scale down to 0
2) send a 1RPS burst of 20 concurrent requests
3) observe KEDA pod creation, readiness flapping, and gateway 504s
Commands:
```
# scale test
hey -n 1000 -c 20 https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
kubectl get pods -w -l app=model-serving
kubectl describe pod <pod>
```
Observed: KEDA poll period caused ~20s delay before scale-up eval, then pod start + model init leads to ~40s additional delay. Gateway timeout configured at 28s for this route.

Sam Ortega: immediate mitigations we can push now (low-risk):
- Increase route gateway timeout from 28s -> 90s for model-serving endpoints (rollback safe, protects customers during coldstarts).
- Set minReplicas=1 for the affected pool (pre-warm) while we investigate traffic patterns and cost impact.

Marie Nguyen: customer-facing message drafted: "We're investigating increased 5xx/timeout errors during bursts. Short-term mitigation in progress (pre-warming and extended gateway timeout). We'll follow up with RCA and permanent config change." Sending to account team.

Sanjay Patel: longer-term fixes:
- Tune KEDA ScaledObject: reduce pollPeriod to 5s for high-QPS routes or use ActiveScaler (if available) to detect queue length and scale faster.
- Update readinessProbe timeout to account for model init distributions or separate init container that only returns readiness when model loaded.
- Introduce an always-on pre-warm pool (minReplicas=1 or a lightweight warmup instance) for critical customers.
- Consider pushing model snapshots to faster storage or keep KV cache warm across restarts to reduce init time.

Emily Park: applying immediate mitigation: increasing gateway timeout + set minReplicas=1 for acme-inc tenant pool. Will monitor metrics and customer contact.

AutoScaleBot: mitigation applied: route timeout updated at 11:28:03 UTC, minReplicas=1 applied at 11:29:10 UTC.

Liao Chen: post-mortem action items assigned:
- Sanjay: run perf test to measure model init time distribution and update readinessProbe to 120s where needed. (owner Sanjay Patel)
- Sam: propose KEDA tuning PR to reduce poll interval and adjust cooldown. (owner Sam Ortega)
- Marie: coordinate customer follow-up and SLA credit if applicable. (owner Marie Nguyen)
- Emily: add runbook snippet for coldstart mitigation. (owner Emily Park)

Sanjay Patel: extra notes: watch out for cost impact of minReplicas=1 across many tenants; consider tenant-tiering. Also confirm autoscaler metrics (prometheus adapter) hasn't missed spike due to scrape lag.

Emily Park: closing loop — I've updated the support ticket and told acme-inc we deployed short-term mitigations. They're seeing reduced 5xxs in last 20m. Will post RCA here when ready. :thumbsup:

AutoScaleBot: incident closed (mitigation) at 11:49:01 UTC. Recommend RFC for autoscale coldstart patterns.
